findings.issue: The apparently lazy anchors generator used itertools.product, which eagerly pools each input range on first iteration.
findings.repair: Nested range loops preserve true laziness; a billion-scale next-anchor check executes without a graph allocation.
findings.validation: No intentionally huge product was executed.
